Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent was instructed to confirm the exact entity that launched Phoenix Hong Kong Channel and its Cayman Islands registration. However, in the subsequent steps, WebSurfer remained focused on generating similar search results without refining the queries to capture definitive registry data. Instead, it repeated searches and queries that pointed towards Phoenix Satellite Television (a correct entity in a general sense) but failed to extract and provide conclusive registry-level documentation from authoritative sources like the Cayman Islands General Registry. Consequently, this resulted in an inability to provide the precise name of the registered entity, creating a cycle of insufficient confirmation typical of "Repeated Attempts without New Evidence" as seen in Example 3.
